messages:
Diego: Heads-up — after landing the q5 quant build for Cobalt-v2 I see a weird token-orphaning pattern on mixed CJK+RTL inputs. BLEU down ~3.1 on our zh->ar devset, token counts look off. Anyone seen this before?
Marina: yikes. do you have a repro snippet?
Diego: repro below. short example: input: `这是测试：هل هذا يعمل؟`
Diego: Cobalt-v2 (float32) output (expected spacing): `这是测试：هل هذا يعمل؟`
Diego: Cobalt-v2 q5 output (observed): `这 是 测 试 ：هل هذا يعمل ؟` — spaces inserted between han characters, and Arabic punctuation detached (extra space before `؟`).
Yuki: hmm that looks like tokenization/detokenization mismatch post-quant. Could be tokenizer -> detok pipeline assuming byte-level merge boundaries changed by quant kernel.
Hao: can you paste the exact command you used to run the quantized eval?
Diego: run: ```
# smoke eval
python -m evals.run --model cobalt-v2:q5 --task zh-ar-dev --batch 64 --detok-mode unified
```
Diego: and we compute BLEU via sacrebleu. Also noticed token length shift: (float32 avg tokens: 42) vs (q5 avg tokens: 58) on same samples.
Marina: that token count explosion would definitely affect beam/softmax alignment. Could be a kcache split or subword merge failing. Did you also try int8 build?
Diego: int8 build (q8x) doesn't show the spacing, perf slightly slower, BLEU stable. This looks specific to q5 path.
EvalBot: automated diff: chrF dropped -0.027, BLEU -3.12, avg token len +38% on zh->ar devset for q5 vs fp32 (run 2026-03-21T09:12Z).
Jess: @Yuki @Hao can we run a minimal tokenizer-only pass with the quantized model's tok step (to see whether the tok or detok is the culprit)?
Yuki: yes — I suspect detok mapping table has an index shift after quantized kernel lookup. Quick test: run tokenizer.encode then tokenizer.decode across the same sequence and compare.
Sofie: I'll spin a tiny bisect: disable cache/kvcache path, run single-sample decode with different kernels. Diego — can you post model sha and runtime flags?
Diego: model sha: c2b3fa9, runtime: marlin-serve v2.4.3, flags: --kernel-path optimized/q5 --cache-enabled true --kv-shard 4
Hao: try with `--cache-enabled false` and `--detok-mode legacy` to isolate. If detok normalizes differently it's probably the detokenizer mapping.
Diego: tried cache=false + legacy detok: spacing mostly fixed but Arabic punctuation still off. With cache=false and legacy detok BLEU recovers +1.8 but not all the way.
Marina: partial fix with cache suggests two issues: 1) kvcache/batching interplay with q5 kernel, 2) q5-specific token map for punctuation.
Yuki: I can instrument the tokenizer to dump token ids for the problematic span. Diego plz run `--dump-tokens=on` for a small sample and paste output.
Diego: pasted token ids: `[2034, 2034, 2034, 34, 7001, 7002, 900]` for the han run — repeating id 2034 suggests subtoken duplication post-kernel.
Hao: duplication at ids is consistent with an index wrap bug in the q5 lookup table (small table overflow). I'll check kernel offsets.
Sofie: opening a runbook issue and adding triage steps. tagging infra-oncall if we need rollback.
Sofie: Issue created: infra/3142 — "Cobalt-v2 q5: token duplication & CJK spacing on mixed inputs". @Marina please add eval artifacts.
Marina: uploading sample batch + sacrebleu logs to the evals dashboard (link: https://console.redwood/api/evals/infra/3142) :eyes:
Jess: if kernel offset is the bug we should hotfix the q5 table generator and push a canary build to staging only (don't roll to Dedicated).
Hao: agree. quick patch idea: add bounds-check when mapping int8->vocab-index and add unit test on mixed-script samples.
Yuki: I'll write the failing unit (sample from Diego) and run local jit with q5 kernel simulator.
Diego: thanks. for immediate mitigation we can pin Cobalt-v2 -> fp32 for production zh->ar routes. I'll create a rollout policy entry in Console.
Sofie: noted. Diego, please add the rollout pin and ETA for revert once patch lands.
Diego: pinned in Console -> routes -> zh-ar-translations to fp32. ETA for patch: ~4h for kernel fix + tests, 1h for canary, 2h for staged verification.
Marina: thanks team. keep replies short here with status updates.
Hao: started branch `q5-fix/vocab-bounds` -> pushing tests. :hammer_and_wrench: 
Yuki: unit tests added, running simulator — initial pass looks promising (no duplication). I'll push artifacts to the issue.
Jess: once canary passes, coordinate with release for a staged rollback plan.
Diego: will monitor eval dashboards and alert if BLEU doesn't recover. :thumbsup:
Marina: closing loop: add a small smoke test to onboarding checklist to run mixed-script zh+ar sample on quantized path. Prevents future regressions.
Diego: agreed. thanks all.
